description: One signal locator at every detail level, then the same locator under a budget it cannot fit. The levels widen rather than reshape: each one's content starts with the previous one's, so a caller comparing summary against full sees added lines and not rewritten ones. last_action appears at every level, including summary, because what the owner did about a signal changes what the signal means and a summary omitting it would read as an open item. context adds the full reaction history with each reaction's own instant — the one place observations appear as evidence in their own right, without ever becoming candidates. The last response truncates at the budget and names the boundary that applied, so a budget cut stays distinguishable from a source-side limit.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
